description: All remaining backend NestJS modules: Users, Roles/Permissions/TenantProvisioning, Tenants, Institution, Departments, Teams, Employees — plus Prisma seed script. Depends on FEAT-002 (auth guards, AuditModule, PrismaService, tenant middleware all available). Independent of FEAT-004 (frontend). Each module follows the thin-controller pattern: controller handles HTTP, service contains business logic, AuditService called on every write.
steps: Create apps/api/src/modules/roles/: permissions.service.ts (getAllPermissions: returns all Permission rows, no tenant scope — permissions are system-wide), roles.service.ts (listRoles: paginated, tenantId scoped; createRole; updateRole; assignPermissionsToRole: replaces all role_permissions for a role in a transaction; assignRoleToUser: upserts user_role_assignments). roles.controller.ts: GET /roles (RequirePermissions roles.view), POST /roles (roles.create), PATCH /roles/:id (roles.update), GET /permissions (roles.view), POST /roles/:id/permissions (roles.update), POST /users/:id/roles (users.update). dtos: CreateRoleDto, UpdateRoleDto, AssignPermissionsDto, AssignRoleDto.

Create apps/api/src/modules/roles/tenant-provisioning.service.ts: provision(tenantId, ownerUserId) method — runs in a Prisma transaction: (1) read default-permissions.ts seed data, upsert all Permission rows (system-global), (2) create 13 Role rows for this tenant (Platform Super Admin, Institution Admin, Executive Director, Research Director, HR Manager, Department Head, Team Lead, Project Manager, Principal Investigator, Researcher, Finance Officer, QA Officer, Auditor), (3) assign permissions to roles per default-role-permissions.ts matrix, (4) create UserRoleAssignment for ownerUserId → Platform Super Admin role. Create prisma/seed-data/default-permissions.ts (array of {code, description, scope} for all permissions: users.view/invite/update, roles.view/create/update, audit.view, institution.view/update, departments.view/create/update/archive, teams.view/create/update, employees.view/create/update/archive, tenants.view). Create prisma/seed-data/default-role-permissions.ts (maps each role name to array of permission codes).

Create prisma/seed.ts: uses PrismaClient directly (not NestJS). Creates one demo tenant (name: 'RIMS Demo Institute', slug: 'demo'), one admin user (email: admin@rims.dev, password hashed with Argon2id), calls tenant-provisioning logic inline (import the seed-data arrays, create roles+permissions+assignments). Creates institution record for demo tenant. Creates 3 sample departments (Research, Administration, HR). Creates 2 sample employees. Guard with if (process.env.SEED_DEMO !== 'true') { return }. Add script to root package.json: prisma:seed: ts-node --project apps/api/tsconfig.json prisma/seed.ts.

Create apps/api/src/modules/tenants/: tenants.service.ts (getCurrentTenant(tenantId): returns tenant + subscription + module entitlements; provisionTenant(dto): calls TenantProvisioningService, creates tenant + owner user + institution record in a transaction). tenants.controller.ts: GET /tenants/current (@RequirePermissions('tenants.view')), POST /tenants/provision (dev-only guard: @SkipAuth() + NODE_ENV check). dtos: TenantResponseDto, ProvisionTenantDto.

Create apps/api/src/modules/users/: users.service.ts (getMe(userId): returns user with roles+permissions; listUsers(tenantId, query): paginated, filter by status/role/department, all scoped to tenantId via where clause; inviteUser(dto, actorId, tenantId): creates Invitation record (type=USER_INVITE) + UserTenantMembership (status=PENDING) + enqueues invitation-email BullMQ job + calls AuditService.log; updateUser(id, dto, actorId, tenantId): updates status/profile, calls AuditService.log; Prisma transaction for multi-step inviteUser). users.controller.ts: GET /me, GET /users (@RequirePermissions users.view), POST /users/invitations (@RequirePermissions users.invite), PATCH /users/:id (@RequirePermissions users.update). dtos: InviteUserDto (email, roleId, departmentId?), UpdateUserDto (status?, firstName?, lastName?, departmentId?).

Create apps/api/src/modules/institution/: institution.service.ts (getInstitution(tenantId): find by tenantId; updateInstitution(tenantId, dto, actorId): update + AuditService.log). institution.controller.ts: GET /institution (@RequirePermissions institution.view), PATCH /institution (@RequirePermissions institution.update). dtos: UpdateInstitutionDto.

Create apps/api/src/modules/departments/: departments.service.ts (getTree(tenantId): $queryRaw recursive CTE — WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS (SELECT ... FROM departments WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND tenant_id = ${tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT d.* FROM departments d JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.parent_id = dt.id) SELECT * FROM dept_tree ORDER BY ...; createDepartment(dto, tenantId, actorId): AuditService.log; updateDepartment(id, dto, actorId, tenantId); archiveDepartment(id, actorId, tenantId): check no active employees (throw 409 if exists), set status=ARCHIVED, archivedAt=now(), AuditService.log). departments.controller.ts: GET /departments, POST /departments, GET /departments/:id, PATCH /departments/:id, POST /departments/:id/archive. dtos: CreateDepartmentDto (name, parentId?), UpdateDepartmentDto.

Create apps/api/src/modules/teams/: teams.service.ts (listTeams, createTeam, updateTeam, addMember(teamId, employeeId) — check employee belongs to same tenant). teams.controller.ts: GET /teams, POST /teams, PATCH /teams/:id, POST /teams/:id/members. Note: if team_memberships join table not in schema, add it to prisma/schema.prisma now (TeamMembership: id, teamId, employeeId, joinedAt, @@map team_memberships).

Create apps/api/src/modules/employees/: employees.service.ts (listEmployees(tenantId, query): paginated, filter by departmentId/status/search on firstName+lastName+email, all tenant-scoped; createEmployee(dto, actorId, tenantId): create employee record, optionally link userId, AuditService.log, Prisma transaction; getEmployee(id, tenantId): with department+position+qualifications; updateEmployee(id, dto, actorId, tenantId): update, AuditService.log; archiveEmployee(id, actorId, tenantId): status=ARCHIVED, archivedAt=now(), AuditService.log). employees.controller.ts: GET /employees, POST /employees, GET /employees/:id, PATCH /employees/:id. dtos: CreateEmployeeDto, UpdateEmployeeDto, EmployeeQueryDto (extends pagination).

Write unit tests: users.service.spec.ts (inviteUser creates invitation + enqueues job, updateUser status transitions, listUsers pagination), departments.service.spec.ts (archiveDepartment throws 409 when active employees exist, tree query returns nested result), employees.service.spec.ts (createEmployee with Prisma transaction mock, listEmployees applies filters). Integration tests: GET /employees?page=1&pageSize=5 returns PaginatedResult envelope, POST /departments/:id/archive on dept with active employees returns 409.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @rims/api test exits 0 with all module unit tests passing
pnpm prisma:seed runs without error (creates demo tenant, 13 roles, admin user)
GET /api/v1/roles returns 13 roles for demo tenant
GET /api/v1/users returns paginated envelope { data: [], meta: { total, page, pageSize, totalPages, requestId } }
POST /api/v1/departments/:id/archive on a department with an active employee returns 409
